abstract: Holds the one Wugweb voice, which is also the owner's voice, and runs the voice check on visible Wugweb copy. Structure, check method and sample ledger only: no voice rule exists until the owner supplies writing samples. The fixed owner rules (British English, sentence case, no em or en dashes, no invented facts, no filler words) are always on. A mechanical check script flags dashes, US spellings, heading case and confirmed banned words, lists every number and quote to trace, and sets confidence from the ledger. One Node script, no packages. Independent of CMS, host and agent.
